first.rationale: The current 4% onboarding-completion decline and 6% activation decline align directly with prior evidence that shorter onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and adoption. Promotional pricing addresses the competitive threat but has documented 30-day retention harm, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the most directly relevant onboarding evidence and the downstream-risk evidence for pricing before committing.

final.rationale: Run shortened onboarding only for simple self-serve accounts, explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts. This directly addresses both declining onboarding completion and activation, while guarding against the verified 60-day churn increase in complex workspaces. Use a holdout and evaluate qualified revenue and retention alongside completion, activation, and time-to-value. Do not pursue promotional pricing because its acquisition lift fails to survive the first renewal cycle.
